ev.q: VAERS received and processed 9,246 reports of adverse events for adolescents aged 12–17 years
Overall, 8,383 (90.7%) VAERS reports were for nonserious events, and 863 (9.3%) for serious events
systemic reactions were more common after dose 2 (63.4%) than dose 1 (48.9%)
609 (70.6%) reports of serious events were among males

methods_quotes.q: FDA used the Multi-Item Gamma Poisson Shrinker algorithm to calculate the Empirical Bayes Geometric Mean and its associated 90% confidence interval
FDA used empirical Bayesian data mining to monitor for disproportional reporting of adverse events by vaccine
SAS software (version 9.4; SAS Institute) was used to conduct all analyses.
VAERS reports for adolescents aged 12–15 years were excluded if vaccination occurred before EUA age expansion on May 10, 2021.
Syncopal events that occurred off-site or ≥1 hour after vaccine administration were excluded from analysis.
